summary: Iteration 7 fully validated. BACKEND (4/4 pytest cases green in test_iteration7_circuits.py): (1) GET /api/circuits without auth returns 401; (2) lat=99 returns 422; (3) distance_km=50 returns 422; (4) authenticated GET /api/circuits?lat=45.9&lon=6.13&distance_km=5 as thomas@pace.app returns 200 with 3 circuits — ids ors0/ors1/ors2, source='openrouteservice', color hex, seed int, duration_min>0, distance_km inside 0.4x-2.2x band, coords list length>=2, and Haversine check on first+last vs start<300m (loop). FRONTEND (mobile viewport 390x844) with geolocation granted at 45.9/6.13: Profile → 'MONTRES CONNECTÉES' — sync-apple-health button ABSENT on web (bug fix confirmed), 'Disponible sur iPhone (après build de l'app)' caption present, no watch-msg error surfaced, no crash. /routes-map screen — circuit-ors0/ors1/ors2 cards rendered with real distances '5.5 km · ~33 min', circuits-source badge shows 'Routes réelles' (green check), selecting a circuit highlights it (border color changes), run-circuit button labelled 'Courir ce circuit (5.5 km · ~33 min)'. Regression — Explore 'open-circuits-map' navigates to /routes-map; /run/active still shows zombie-toggle. No red-screen errors, no ORS 502s hit, only benign expo-notifications warnings on web. Code review of src/health.ts confirms isExpoGo export (Constants.appOwnership==='expo' OR executionEnvironment==='storeClient') and HealthConnectResult.reason typed union covering ok/expo_go/not_ios/module_missing/unavailable/denied_or_error; profile.tsx HEALTH_MESSAGES map covers all 5 non-ok reasons with clear French guidance. Native iOS path untestable in web preview per brief.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1370 lines — extracting the ORS circuits + watch-workouts routers would improve maintainability, though no functional impact.
In /api/circuits, `random.sample(range(1,100000), 5)` fires 5 ORS calls per request; if quota pressure grows, consider dropping to 3 seeds (the endpoint already keeps only ok[:3]).
profile.tsx still uses `msg.includes('plan')` / `msg.includes('réglages')` string-sniffing for message routing (pre-existing) — brittle if copy changes.
circuits response: `duration_min` is derived from a fixed 6:00/km pace on the server; the ORS-returned `duration_s` (walking pace) is discarded. Fine for a running estimate but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created — /api/circuits is read-only (ORS proxy).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (fallback to hardcoded preview URL in test file). Login testIDs on /auth are auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button (NOT login-email/login-password). ORS free tier is 40 req/min and each /api/circuits fans out 5 ORS calls — keep circuit generations under 4 per test run and space them out. The circuits endpoint at 45.9/6.13 (Annecy) reliably returns 3 loops around 5-6 km even when 8 km is requested (ORS honours the 0.4x-2.2x server band). Iteration 7 backend regression baseline at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_circuits.py.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification only, no bugs found.
